items.name: ByteLines
items.summary: An iterator over lines from an instance of [`std::io::BufRead`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/io/trait.BufRead.html).

items.name: ByteRecords
items.summary: An iterator over records from an instance of [`std::io::BufRead`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/io/trait.BufRead.html).

items.name: BufReadExt
items.summary: An extension trait for [`std::io::BufRead`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/io/trait.BufRead.html) which provides convenience APIs for dealing with byte strings.

methods.name: byte_lines
methods.signature: fn byte_lines(self) -> ByteLines<Self> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the lines of this reader, where each line is represented as a byte string.

methods.name: byte_records
methods.signature: fn byte_records(self, terminator: u8) -> ByteRecords<Self> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over byte-terminated records of this reader, where each record is represented as a byte string.

methods.name: for_byte_line
methods.signature: fn for_byte_line<F>(&mut self, for_each_line: F) -> io::Result<()> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(&[u8]) -> io::Result<bool>
methods.summary: Executes the given closure on each line in the underlying reader.

methods.name: for_byte_line_with_terminator
methods.signature: fn for_byte_line_with_terminator<F>(&mut self, for_each_line: F) -> io::Result<()> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(&[u8]) -> io::Result<bool>
methods.summary: Executes the given closure on each line in the underlying reader.

methods.name: for_byte_record
methods.signature: fn for_byte_record<F>(&mut self, terminator: u8, for_each_record: F) -> io::Result<()> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(&[u8]) -> io::Result<bool>
methods.summary: Executes the given closure on each byte-terminated record in the underlying reader.

methods.name: for_byte_record_with_terminator
methods.signature: fn for_byte_record_with_terminator<F>(&mut self, terminator: u8, for_each_record: F) -> io::Result<()> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(&[u8]) -> io::Result<bool>
methods.summary: Executes the given closure on each byte-terminated record in the underlying reader.
